legend: The Bloody Benders (Kansas, USA, 1873 inn legend)
lines: Kansas, eighteen seventy-three: a lonely inn on the empty prairie.
A family named Bender runs it, and daughter Kate claims she can heal and speak to spirits.
Travelers stop for supper and a bed.
But some of them are never seen again.
Search parties start asking questions, and the family grows nervous.
When neighbors finally visit, the inn stands empty.
The animals are starving, and the Benders are gone.
Behind the house, legend says, searchers find a strange, freshly dug orchard.
The family was never found, and the stories never stopped.
Did they escape, or did the prairie swallow them? What do you think?
title: The Kansas Inn Where Travelers Vanished: The Bloody Benders #shorts
description:
In 1873, a family-run inn on the Kansas prairie became the center of one of America's strangest vanishing stories. Where did the Benders go?
